# Xinyuan Liu

> Xinyuan Liu is a computer science PhD student at Arizona State University (LENS Lab), advised by Ransalu Senanayake. She works on information-efficient AI systems: online LLM selection and routing, cognitive evaluation for humanoid robots, LLM orchestration of multi-robot systems, and multimodal learning for surgical and medical systems.
> Contact: xinyua11@asu.edu

## Research focus

- Online LLM selection and routing from limited preference feedback
- Cognitive and human-factors evaluation of humanoid robots
- LLM orchestration of multi-robot crews with enforced execution contracts
- Imitation learning and behavior cloning for embodied agents
- Multimodal learning for surgical and medical systems

## Publications

- [Physical Agentic AI: An Architecture for Orchestrating a Robot Crew with LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22657) — arXiv preprint, 2026. An LLM mission planner proposes a structured plan over typed skill registries but never actuates; a procedural orchestrator holds sole actuation authority and checks every step against declarative workflow contracts at dispatch time. Instantiated on a real Unitree G1 humanoid and Go2 quadruped, and on an air-ground search-and-rescue stack in Gazebo. Authors: Xinyuan Liu, Eren Sadikoglu, Riana Chatterjee, Ransalu Senanayake. Code: https://github.com/Liuuuxy/physical-agentic-ai
- [CUPID in the Model Zoo: Online Matchmaking for Selecting Your Dream LLM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00846) — ICML 2026. An online method for matching a user to a language model from a large zoo: a contextual bandit over a Gaussian-process posterior turns a handful of pairwise preference judgements into a personalized choice, evaluated against an LMArena-style Bradley-Terry baseline in a live arena study. Authors: Son Nguyen, Xinyuan Liu, Ransalu Senanayake.
- [Humanoid Factors: Design Principles for AI Humanoids in Human Worlds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.10069) — arXiv preprint, 2026; abridged version "Cognitive Models as Evaluation Primitives in Humanoid Factors" at the ICLR 2026 Workshop on From Human Cognition to AI Reasoning. Proposes humanoid factors — physical, cognitive, social and ethical pillars — and applies the framework to a real humanoid control algorithm to show what task-completion metrics leave out. Authors: Xinyuan Liu, Eren Sadikoglu, Ransalu Senanayake, Lixiao Huang.
- [LLM Routing as Reasoning: A MaxSAT View](https://openreview.net/forum?id=Qmr9VbwRaB) — ICLR 2026 Workshop on Logical Reasoning of Large Language Models. Authors: Son Nguyen, Xinyuan Liu, Ransalu Senanayake.
- [Neural-Augmented Kelvinlet for Real-Time Soft Tissue Deformation Modeling](https://openreview.net/forum?id=GuJ2804iwL) — AAAI 2025. Augments analytic Kelvinlet elastic solutions with a learned component so soft-tissue deformation can be modeled at interactive rates. Authors: Ashkan Shahbazi, Kyvia Pereira, Jon S. Heiselman, Elaheh Akbari, Annie Benson, Sepehr Seifi, Xinyuan Liu, Garrison L. H. Johnston, Jie Ying Wu, Nabil Simaan, Michael Miga, Soheil Kolouri.
